# Loft Curtains

> Premium custom curtains and drapery manufacturer specializing in extra-long, extra-wide, eco-friendly window treatments with Belgian linen and Oeko-Tex certified fabrics.

Loft Curtains offers made-to-measure curtains in multiple heading styles (ripplefold, grommet, pleats) with signature collections including Canvas, Flow, Grace, and Belgian linen lines from Flanders. The company serves both residential and commercial clients with NFPA 701 certified fire retardant options and maintains a Beverly Hills showroom.

## Key Topics

- Custom Curtains
- Ripplefold Drapery
- Belgian Linen
- Extra Long/Wide Curtains
- Canvas Collection
- Flow Collection
- Grace Collection
- Pleat Styles (Tailored, French)
- Blackout Lining
- Semi-Sheer Curtains
- Oeko-Tex Certified Fabrics
- NFPA 701 Fire Retardant
- Curtain Heading Styles
- Made-to-Measure Drapery

## Custom Curtain Products

- [Custom Curtains and Drapes - Extra Wide/Long Drapery](https://www.loftcurtains.com/products/custom-curtains): Main custom curtains product page: eco-friendly, made-to-measure drapery
- [Custom Ripplefold Curtains and Drapes - Extra Long/Wide Drapery](https://www.loftcurtains.com/products/ripple-fold-custom-order): Custom ripplefold curtains: Oeko-Tex certified, extra long/wide options
- [Custom Curtains Los Angeles - Extra Long Extra Wide Drapery](https://www.loftcurtains.com/pages/custom-curtains-los-angeles): Los Angeles custom curtains with Beverly Hills showroom location

## Fabric Collections

- [CANVAS Collection - Cotton Extra Long Curtain Panels](https://www.loftcurtains.com/collections/canvas-collection): CANVAS collection: cotton-blend cross-weave extra long curtain panels
- [Belgian Linen Collections](https://www.loftcurtains.com/pages/belgian-linen-collections): Belgian linen curtain collections from Flanders: Antwerp, Lille, Spa
- [PROVENCE - Belgian Linen Textured Semi-Sheer](https://www.loftcurtains.com/collections/provence-collection): PROVENCE collection: Belgian linen multi-colored textured semi-sheer
- [MOTIF - Textured Weave Patterned Semi-Sheer](https://www.loftcurtains.com/collections/motif-collection): MOTIF collection: textured weave patterned semi-sheer curtains
- [SPRING - Floral Pattern Embroidered Semi-Sheer](https://www.loftcurtains.com/collections/spring-collection): SPRING collection: floral embroidered semi-sheer custom curtains
- [MIST - Plain Weave Voile Sheer](https://www.loftcurtains.com/collections/mist-collection): MIST collection: minimal plain weave voile sheer curtains
- [Paradise - Feather Pattern Jacquard Fabric](https://www.loftcurtains.com/collections/paradise-collection): Paradise collection: organic feather pattern jacquard fabric curtains

## Curtain Guides & How-To

- [What is Ripple-fold Curtains? How to Measure?](https://www.loftcurtains.com/blogs/curtain-guide/all-about-ripple-fold-style-curtains): Ripple-fold curtains guide: measuring and installation instructions
- [How to Decide on Curtain Fullness - Ripple Fold and Grommet](https://www.loftcurtains.com/blogs/curtain-guide/how-to-decide-on-curtain-fullness): Curtain fullness guide with stackback calculator for ripple fold & grommet
- [Which Curtain Heading Style Should I Choose?](https://www.loftcurtains.com/blogs/curtain-guide/which-curtain-heading-style-should-i-choose): Curtain heading styles comparison: rod pocket, grommet, pleats, ripple fold
- [How Wide Should Curtains Be?](https://www.loftcurtains.com/blogs/archieve/how-wide-should-curtains-be): Curtain width measurement guide: 1.5-2.5x window width recommended
- [Flame and Fire Retardant Fabrics - NFPA 701 Certified](https://www.loftcurtains.com/blogs/curtain-guide/flame-and-fire-retardant-fabrics): NFPA 701 certified fire retardant fabrics for commercial curtains
